portfolio_gates.before_build: Pin source revision, actual engine version, target platform, asset versions and donor dependencies; do not assume existing candidates are verified.
portfolio_gates.per_slice: Record exact build/test commands, revision, platform, passed/failed/blocked/not_run and evidence. Capture one readable hero screenshot, a 30–60 second mechanic clip and a short trailer when ready.
portfolio_gates.reuse: Move reusable rules only after a second independent consumer validates the interface. Keep authored content and engine adapters separate.
portfolio_gates.cross_engine: Use behavior contracts and tests across engines; do not copy Unreal runtime code into Godot or assume an incomplete port works.
portfolio_gates.assets: Use the GameCore hub registry to locate ModelForge model/rig/material versions, SoundCore cues and SonicAlchemist music/stems. Pin identity, rights and compatibility; sound candidates need audition.
portfolio_gates.coverage: A planned assignment does not close a gap. A first playable closes only accepted capabilities, not its entire later milestone list.
